image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, grey rocky surface. The salamander displays characteristic glossy black skin with irregular, vivid yellow patches and spots along its back, head, and limbs. Its body is robust and cylindrical, with short, stout limbs visible. The head is broad, and the tail extends towards the right side of the frame, appearing laterally compressed. The lighting highlights the moist, glandular texture of the skin.
